definitions.explanation: Happening quickly and dramatically, often implying an extreme or severe change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急激|きゅうげき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
{急激|きゅうげき}⟦な→な：03496_na⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ついていけない→ついていく：10991_tsuiteiku⟧。
examples.english: I can't keep up with the rapid changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急激|きゅうげき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}した→増加する：03329_zouka⟧。

notes:
{急激|きゅうげき} emphasizes both speed and intensity of change.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {急激|きゅうげき}な⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (drastic change)
- {急激|きゅうげき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧/⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ (to increase/decrease rapidly)
- {急激|きゅうげき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧ (to worsen rapidly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急激|きゅうげき}: sudden, drastic (implies intensity)
- ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧: rapid (emphasizes speed)
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧: sudden (basic term)
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: sudden, unexpected (emphasizes surprise)
